key_insight: FaithMed teaches medical LLMs to reason with evidence step by step, aiming to make answers both more accurate and more faithfully justified.
clinical_relevance: For AI-assisted medicine, this could improve the transparency and reliability of model explanations when evidence needs to support clinical decisions.
method: Turns evidence-based medicine principles into process-level rubrics
Uses clinician-designed rubrics that are automatically refined
Applies reinforcement learning with step-level process reward assignment and advantage grouping
evidence_signal: Across seven medical benchmarks, FaithMed outperformed agentic-search baselines by 9% on average and outcome-only RL by 5.8%, while improving rubric scores by 15.5% over agentic-search Qwen3 baselines.
watch_item: The approach depends on rubric quality and reliable evidence retrieval, so performance may vary if the evidence source is weak or the process criteria do not generalize well.
paper_title: FaithMed: Training LLMs For Faithful Evidence-Based Medical Reasoning
